posts.text:
Fansite terbesar T.O.P ngumumin tutup setelah 20 tahun nemenin dari 2006.

Banyak yang ngira ini murni drama fans ngambek gara-gara T.O.P go public pacaran sama Nana. 

Ternyata aslinya jauh lebih toxic dari itu.

Menurut CHOIDOT, isu kencan cuma jadi pemicu meledaknya bom waktu dari kebobrokan agensi T.O.P (TOPSPOT PICTURES) yang selama ini ngejadiin fansite sebagai 'babu gratisan'.

Berikut 'dosa-dosa' agensinya dan kenapa fansite ini akhirnya fed up 👇

1. Agensi Lepas Tangan & Fansite Dijadiin CS Gratisan.

TOPSPOT PICTURES sama sekali nggak punya saluran komunikasi resmi kayak email atau komunitas fans. Ujung-ujungnya, fansite yang harus turun tangan jadi penghubung, bahkan sampai ngurusin pertanyaan dari fans global.

2. Eksploitasi Duit & Waktu Fansite.

Fansite patungan ngumpulin dana sampai 10 juta won buat pasang iklan comeback T.O.P di 8 titik lokasi yang berbeda. Lucunya, agensi malah nggak ketahuan pasang iklan di mana, tapi berani-beraninya ikut campur ngerevisi desain iklan bikinan fansite sampai larut malam.

3. Fansite Disuruh Jadi 'Polisi' & Event Organizer.

Agensi sering banget nyuruh fansite buat nertibin fans lain, kayak minta tolong hapusin foto-foto unofficial di medsos. Nggak cuma itu, saking nggak punya staf profesional yang mumpuni, agensi sampai minta saran teknis ke fansite buat ngurus acara, termasuk nanya link beli gelas sampanye.

4. Minta Materi Tapi Dighosting

Pas ada event resmi, agensi minta foto resolusi tinggi ke fansite buat diposting di Fanclub Jepang. Fansite udah gercep ngirimin, eh ujung-ujungnya foto itu nggak pernah diposting atau dipakai sama sekali.

5. Nutupin Promosi & Konser yang Bobrok.

Tiket VIP di Hong Kong dijual mahal banget (sekitar 300 ribu won), tapi benefitnya ampas (cuma soundcheck 5 menit & send-off 30 detik). Pas fans ngamuk minta refund, agensi nggak nyediain tempat komplain, jadi fansite lagi-lagi yang jadi tameng sasaran marah. Terus pas konser di Taipei sepi penonton, agensi ketahuan upload foto editan manipulasi cahaya buat nutupin kursi kosong, yang akhirnya buru-buru dihapus.

6. Puncak Masalah (Tragedi Batal Pameran)

Fansite bikin pameran pakai uang pribadi dengan modal awal sekitar 9 juta won. Dari awal peminatnya emang lesu, cuma 20an orang yang daftar di minggu pertama. Nah, pas berita kencan T.O.P & Nana rilis, badai cancelation makin parah sampai sisa 10-15% peserta per hari. Fansite nombok rugi sampai 7 juta Won dan akhirnya terpaksa ngebatalin acara.

7. Agensi Gaslighting & Playing Victim

Fansite sebenernya udah tahu T.O.P pacaran dari lama dan diam aja demi ngehargain privasi artis. Demi transparansi dan biar fans luar negeri nggak rugi tiket pesawat, fansite ngumumin alasan batalnya pameran karena sepi peminat. Bukannya instrospeksi, agensinya malah ngamuk karena masalah reservation rate yang rendah itu dibongkar ke publik. Agensi lalu mendistorsi fakta seolah-olah fansite tutup murni karena fans marah idolnya pacaran.

8. Kekecewaan Mendalam Sama T.O.P

Fansite ngerasa T.O.P nggak nepatin janji. Katanya bikin album buat fans, tapi 5 bulan rilis malah nggak ada panggung atau komunikasi sama sekali. Fansite merasa T.O.P cuma mau dengerin orang-orang yang 'asal bapak senang' dan nganggep dukungan fans itu hal yang otomatis ada kapanpun dia butuh.

Hmmmmm~ pelik juga ya masalahnya 🤔

posts.text:
Brewing up baby stars ⭐

@NASAWebb used infrared light to peer through the dust in this nebula, revealing many stars of different ages. This helps us study how stars change over time. https://t.co/G16OCOgT6s

media.alt: A young star cluster filled with many stars that display Webb’s unique eight-pronged diffraction pattern. At its center is a yellow star which sports the largest diffraction pattern. To the left of the star, there is a region filled with yellow dust and gas. This yellow region extends from the bottom, covering about two-thirds of the image. The yellow region has several blue stars of different sizes embedded within. The top third, which lies outside of the yellow region, holds a few bright protostars, within dense gray gas. Those stars illuminate the gas, making it appear blue. A few red outflows from other protostars are visible above this grayish-blue region. To the right of the central star, there is a clumpy, flame-like plume of red dust and gas with protostars that emit a soft white light within. The plume is surrounded by more dense gray gas and dust.

posts.text:
Most of the recent math results were not reached by a swarm, the way Navier–Stokes was. I think that part got lost in the excitement around the release. OpenAI's unnamed internal model, which I'm going to call Aeon, reached most of them in one shot, from a single prompt, with no interruptions. This model did not even exist before the end of August, and it is still training. Notice how the returns are not dropping off? That chart is from a month ago. It is a log scale. What does Aeon look like now? 

On average, each result used three hours of thinking. Aeon was given 4000 problems to work on by OpenAI. How many more have been solved in the last three days? That number is not zero. 

It's like hearing notes in a song that is slowly rising. I don't think Pacing the Frontier was just about Hugging Face or hacking. They've seen how close we are to closing the loop, and as the hour draws near, their resolve begins to quaver. The last piece was model creativity, and I think that threshold was crossed internally by Anthropic and OpenAI in September. You see it in Opus 5.5, which gets it from Fable 5.5. You see it in the math results from Aeon.

All that was needed to start the event was the ability for models to think of novel ways to improve themselves. That was the last piece. This is directly analogous to the ability to think of strange, alien ways to solve math problems: solutions so inhuman that they are difficult to express in existing human terms, so the proof winds up incomprehensible. I think these same kinds of alien solutions are now being applied to model improvements internally. That's what all this recent consternation is really about. They see the invisible frontier. And they see what is about to happen.
